title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 9: Supply Chain & Procurement Contracts
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Titan Logistics con the Procurement Director.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Titan Logistics

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Titan Logistics** (Líder a cargo: **the Procurement Director**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Titan Logistics's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are signing the supplier agreement. B) They are inspecting raw materials. C) The shipping container is being loaded. D) They are negotiating the purchase orders.
questions.explanation: Los ejecutivos están sentados discutiendo las cláusulas y montos de las órdenes de compra de materias primas.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi John, did the procurement team at Titan Logistics approve the contract?
W: Yes. The Procurement Director wants us to submit the finalized purchase orders in FlexCRM.
M: I will handle the system upload right away.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
